material.text: Five clean waves up from Mar 9 to Aug 13 (+27%, wave 1). The pullback has reached the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (+2.7% to −1.6%), in three waves, with the 50-day average and the Jun 1 low in the same place. It is the second wave of a larger wave 3: five waves up from Jun 25, 2025 to Jan 21 and a pullback of 0.72 of them to the Mar 9 low came first, so the end of this wave 2 starts wave 3 of 3, the strongest move a chart makes.
